2. His extreme weight was due to massive fluid retention and severe generalized edema, alongside compulsive overeating.
3. Anorexia nervosa is an eating disorder characterized by an abnormally low body weight, an intense fear of gaining weight, and a distorted perception of weight. 
4. Minnoch's condition was the exact opposite of anorexia nervosa; he suffered from morbid obesity and related complications.
